generate_code2seq_datapoints: run the CLI tool to generate terminal-to-terminal path datapoints from an AST file for code2seq training
extract_ast_paths: extract terminal-to-terminal paths from a Python AST with configurable max path length and path count
get_leaf_nodes_by_type: get indices of specific leaf node types like attr, num, name, or param from an AST
load_word_to_index_vocab: load a pickled vocabulary file and return a word-to-index mapping with an unknown token fallback
tokenize_ast_terminal_words: tokenize terminal words from an AST and map paths to vocabulary indices for model input
